# DJ Litvin

> Professional DJ based in Warsaw. Available for corporate events, weddings, brand launches, fashion shows, and private parties. Performs across Europe.

DJ Litvin (Gennady Litvin) is a Warsaw-based professional DJ with over 6 years of experience and 500+ events performed. He specializes in corporate events, weddings, brand launches, fashion shows, and private parties. Trusted by international brands including Disney, Coca-Cola, Deloitte, Santander Bank, Volkswagen, Philips, and BetterMe. He speaks English, Polish, and Russian, and is available for events in Warsaw, across Poland, and throughout Europe.

Contact: booking@litvindj.com | +48 884 325 413

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/litvin.dj
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@litvindj
